Author: Harbor
Description: Type a calculation and see the answer immediately. Parentheses work too.

Author: Harbor
Description: Put a clock and date on your desktop. Choose their size and format.

Name: Dock App Labels
Author: Harbor
Description: Show app names or window titles next to taskbar icons. Choose how wide labels can be.

Name: Drive Space
Author: Harbor
Description: See how much space is free on each drive you choose.

Author: Harbor
Description: A warm dark theme with peach accents. Every color is editable.

Author: Harbor

Name: Forest
Author: Harbor

Author: Harbor
Description: Middle-click a taskbar app to close one of its windows. Save prompts still appear.

Author: Harbor

Author: Harbor

Name: Quick Folders
Author: Harbor
Description: Keep your favorite folders one click away. They open in Harbor Files.

Name: Quick Notes
Author: Harbor
Description: Write a quick note on your desktop. Your text saves as you type.

Author: Harbor
Description: Remember where you put an app. Reopening it restores that position. Games are skipped.

Author: Harbor
Description: See CPU, RAM, drive space, and uptime together in one panel.

Author: Harbor
Description: Scroll on the top Dock to change system volume. You can require Alt to avoid accidental changes.

Name: Scroll to Switch Windows
Author: Harbor
Description: Scroll over a taskbar app to switch between its open windows.

Name: Sound Desk
Author: Harbor
Description: Adjust volume, mute audio, and control music from one desktop panel.

Author: Harbor
Description: Time an activity from zero. Pause or reset whenever you need.

Author: Harbor
Description: Watch CPU and memory usage. The graph shows recent CPU activity.

Name: Unit Converter
Author: Harbor

Author: Harbor
Description: See how long Windows has been running since the last full restart.

Author: Harbor

Author: Harbor
